interventions.detail: paddlepaddle 3.3.0 CPU oneDNN executor crashes on PP-OCRv6 det (pir::ArrayAttribute<DoubleAttribute> unsupported); disabled MKLDNN via PADDLE_PDX_ENABLE_MKLDNN_BYDEFAULT=False
apt install libgl1 libglib2.0-0 libgomp1 for opencv/paddle runtime (precautionary)
README only shows pip install paddlex[base]; installed from clone with -e .[ocr] in a uv Python 3.12 venv
Set PADDLE_PDX_MODEL_SOURCE=BOS and PADDLE_PDX_DISABLE_MODEL_SOURCE_CHECK=True for deterministic model downloads
